description: Deploy a solution FROM its GitHub repo. Reads .ateam/export.json + connector source from the repo and feeds it into the deploy pipeline. Use this to restore a previous version or deploy from GitHub as the source of truth. It REPLACES the Builder's copy of each file with the repo's (`dev`). Where the Builder holds a change that never reached GitHub (a save held off `dev`, one whose push failed, a file changed on both sides), that change would exist nowhere afterwards, so the pull is REFUSED (409 UNPUSHED_BUILDER_CHANGE, naming the files) before anything is uploaded or deployed — unless you pass discard_builder_changes:true, the explicit way to take `dev`'s copy of a file changed on both sides, or to drop such a change. To keep the change instead, ateam_redeploy(solution_id) writes it to `dev` first.

discard_builder_changes.description: true = drop any Builder change that never reached GitHub, replacing it with the repo's copy. Only when you mean to lose it: without it, a pull that would drop one is refused and names the files.

solution_id.description: The solution ID to pull and deploy from GitHub

name: ateam_github_pull
